name: Beneil Dariush
photo_coverage: 8 photos: 1 embeddable (Commons, U.S. Army National Guard photo, 2018), 7 reference-only. Front: ESPN studio headshot (Apr 2026) and the Nov 2025 presser. Profile: Perth faceoff, May 2026 (right side). Body: two ESPN stance shots, the Dec 2023 octagon photo and the Nov 2025 faceoff (back). The 2018 Commons photo is old (dark curly hair) and only useful for structure and hair texture.

face.shape: Long, fairly narrow oval face with high cheekbones and lean, slightly hollow cheeks; longer than wide, tapering gently to a medium chin.
face.jaw: Moderately defined, medium width, angle sits under the ears; visible under short stubble.
face.chin: Medium width, rounded, average projection (in line with the lips in profile).
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, with deep nasolabial folds running from the nose to the mouth corners.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate, with a slightly furrowed glabella.
face.forehead: Medium height and fairly broad, with horizontal lines; hairline straight with a slight recession at the temples.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium opening, slightly deep-set, outer corners level to slightly down.

eyebrows.shape: Gently arched, with the inner ends slightly raised and the tails dropping, which gives a mildly concerned look at rest.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown to black with a few grey hairs.

nose.length: Long; the most prominent feature in profile.
nose.width: Narrow bridge, medium at the base.
nose.hump: None to very slight; the profile is close to straight (Perth faceoff).

mouth.resting_expression: Closed and neutral; smiles with the lips closed and the cheeks lifting into deep folds (Nov 2025 presser).

ears.protrusion: Strongly protruding on both sides, standing well off the head in the front view; a key recognition cue.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Not obvious; the folds are visible and the rims look only slightly thick. Model as large, protruding, otherwise normal ears.
ears.notes: In profile (Perth) the right ear stands out at an angle of roughly 30-40 degrees from the skull.

face.notable_marks_scars: No clear permanent scars at these resolutions. A UFC 317 post-fight press photo (June 2025, viewed but not kept) shows swelling and cuts around the eyes; do not model fight damage.

hair.style: Short, neat cut: about 2.5-3 cm on top brushed up and slightly forward, tapered short on the sides and back (about 1 cm), no part. Earlier (2018) he wore it longer and curly.
hair.colour: Salt-and-pepper, now mostly silver-grey (ESPN Apr 2026, Perth May 2026), with darker hair still showing through on the crown and top; the sides are greyer than the top. In 2023 it was still mostly black with grey at the temples.
hair.hairline: Straight with mild recession at the temples; dense on top.
hair.texture: Wavy to curly when grown out (2018 photo); at the current length it reads as short and slightly wavy.
hair.colour_hex_note: Mean of the three lighter samples (region median, region mid-tones, side point).

facial_hair.colour: Salt-and-pepper: dark brown/black stubble with scattered grey, greyest at the chin.
facial_hair.density: Even and fairly dense over the jaw, chin, upper lip and the lower cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 2-4 mm in studio and press photos; a little longer (about 5-8 mm) in the May 2026 profile.
facial_hair.shape: Full-coverage stubble with a natural, fairly low cheek line and the neck line just under the jaw.
facial_hair.colour_hex_note: Mean of the chin region median and mid-tones.

skin.tone_note: tone_hex uses the five studio and press samples; the 2018 daylight samples are cooler and shaded.
skin.freckles_marks: None notable. Dense dark body hair on the chest, forearms, shins and thighs (greying a little on the chest in 2026).

body.build: Lean, wiry lightweight frame of average height (178 cm) with slightly long arms (183 cm reach).
body.body_fat_notes: Lean with visible abdominal outline but not shredded (ESPN 2026); defined back in the Nov 2025 faceoff.
body.shoulders: Medium-broad with defined, not bulky, deltoids.
body.chest: Moderate pecs covered with dark chest hair.
body.arms: Lean and long-looking, sinewy forearms, modest biceps.
body.legs_calves: Lean, defined thighs and calves, hairy.
body.posture: Upright with the head level and shoulders relaxed; slightly narrow, compact stance in the octagon photo.
body.notable_physique_traits: Wiry rather than bulky; heavy body hair; no tattoos.

fight_stance.observed: No striking-stance photo is in this set (studio, presser, faceoff and a standing octagon shot only).
fight_stance.modelling_note: Southpaw: right hand and right foot lead. Guard details are not observed here.

tattoos_note: None visible on the chest, abdomen, arms, legs or back in any photo (front, back and both sides covered).
accessories_seen: Wedding-style band on the left ring finger (Nov 2025 presser).

kit.typical_shorts: Recent UFC-issued shorts in royal blue with the tonal wave pattern, UFC wordmark on the waistband and his right thigh, crypto.com logo low on his right leg (ESPN 2026). Dec 2023: blue UFC shorts with a Monster logo. Older (2023 or before): black Venum-era shorts with a red DARIUSH wordmark on his left leg.
kit.shorts_colours_note: Region samples from the ESPN stance PNG (40-80 percentile mean, 75th and 25th percentiles).
kit.gloves: Standard UFC 4 oz gloves with corner-coloured cuffs (red in Dec 2023).

morphs_not_in_embed._note: Ear targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (not in mh-manifest.json): large, strongly protruding ears. l-/r- are his own left and right.

notes: Confidence: high for hair colour, stubble, eyes, skin, the absence of tattoos and the protruding ears; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for morph values. 8 photos, 1 embeddable (2018, outdated hair). What to watch: (1) Recognition cues: long oval face with high cheekbones and deep smile folds, long straight high-bridged nose, large ears that stick far out, short silver-grey hair (greyer at the sides) and salt-and-pepper stubble. (2) Do not use the black curly hair from 2018 or the dark hair of the 2023 studio shot; as of 2026 the hair is mostly grey. (3) Warm golden-olive skin and heavy dark body hair; no tattoos anywhere. (4) Lean, wiry build with a narrow waist. (5) In the eyebrows, the inner ends sit a little higher than the tails; eyebrows-angle-down is used for that, so check the direction of that target visually. Macro values: ageOldM = (37-25)/65; heightDownM 0.02 from 2*(1.785-1.778)/0.875.
